title: Uniform provisions concerning the approval of power-driven vehicles with handlebars with regard to their protection against unauthorized use (Anti-theft, mopeds/motorcycles)
scope_summary: Approves a vehicle type with regard to its protection against unauthorized use by a protective device that positively locks the steering or the transmission, optionally combined with engine de-activation. It applies to L-category vehicles (L1 to L7) fitted with handlebars.
scope_quote: This Regulation applies to vehicles of categories L1 to L7, 1/ if fitted with handlebars.
applies_to_components: Protective device (anti-theft system preventing unauthorized use)
Steering lock acting on the steering (handlebars, steering head and its accessory cladding, steering shaft)
Device which de-activates the engine of the vehicle, when combined with the steering lock
Transmission lock (positive locking action of the transmission)
Mountings of the protective device on the vehicle
relation_to_other_regulations: Vehicle categories L1 to L7 are as defined in Annex 7 to the Consolidated Resolution on the Construction of Vehicles (R.E.3), TRANS/WP.29/78/Rev.1/Amend.2 as amended by Amend.4.

Para. 4.5: when the vehicle is also approved under one or more other Regulations annexed to the 1958 Agreement in the same country, the circle-E symbol need not be repeated and the regulation and approval numbers are placed in vertical columns to its right.
The approval number begins with 00, indicating the original version of the Regulation with no series of amendments.

defined_terms.definition: The approval of a vehicle type with regard to its protection against unauthorized use.

A category of power-driven vehicles that do not differ in the manufacturer's type indications, the arrangement and design of the component(s) on which the protective device acts, or the type of protective device.
A system designed to prevent unauthorized use of the vehicle by a positive locking action of the steering or of the transmission.
A protective device operated solely and positively on the steering alone.
A protective device operated positively on the steering in conjunction with the device which de-activates the engine of the vehicle.
A pre-loaded protective device operating on the steering in conjunction with the device which de-activates the engine of the vehicle.
A protective device operated positively on the transmission.
The steering control (handlebars), the steering head and its accessory cladding, the steering shaft and all other components which directly affect the effectiveness of the protective device.
One of the specifically planned and constructed variations of a locking system which, when properly activated, permits operation of the locking system.
Any device designed and constructed to operate a locking system that is designed and constructed to be operated only by that device.

applicability_hints: Applies only to L-category vehicles steered by handlebars, including mopeds, motorcycles, tricycles and quadricycles (e.g. ATVs) with handlebars; L-vehicles with a steering wheel are outside its scope.
A combined ignition switch/steering lock (lock acting on steering plus engine de-activation) is a type 2 or type 3 protective device covered by this Regulation.
Transmission locks are covered as type 4 protective devices, not only steering locks.

'Steering' includes the handlebars, steering head, accessory cladding (fairings/covers around the steering head) and steering shaft, so changes to these parts can affect the approval if they influence the protective device's effectiveness.
Keys and lock combinations (the number of key variations) belong to the protective device system and fall under its requirements.
This is a whole-vehicle approval: the lock is not approved as a separate component; changing the lock type or its mounting needs a new approval or an extension (section 7, para. 4.2).
The approval mark is placed on the vehicle near or on the manufacturer's data plate, not on the lock.
